privacy.title: Manufar Sirri
privacy.intro: Ajiya Ta ("mu", "namu") ta himmatu wajen kare sirrin masu amfani da ita. An kafa wannan manufar bisa **Dokar N° 2017-28 ta 3 ga Mayu 2017** game da kare bayanan sirri a Jamhuriyar Nijar da kuma **Ƙarin Dokar A/SA.1/01/10 ta ECOWAS**.
privacy.consent: Ta hanyar amfani da Ajiya Ta, kun yarda da tattarawa da sarrafa bayananku kamar yadda aka bayyana a ƙasa.
privacy.identification_list:
• Cikakken suna da sunan mai amfani
• Adireshin imel da/ko lambar waya
• Zaɓuɓɓukan asusu da kuɗin waje (XOF, USD, da sauransu)
privacy.financial_list:
• Bayanan ma'amaloli (kuɗin shiga, kuɗin fita, canja wuri)
• Kasafin kuɗi, manufofin ajiya da rukunoni
• Hotuna / sikanin rasit ko daftari (idan an ba da izini)
privacy.technical_list:
• Nau'in na'ura da sigar tsarin Android/iOS
• Alamomin shigarwa na musamman na app
privacy.storage_desc: Dangane da ƙa'idar gine-gine "Offline-First", duk bayanan kuɗin ku ana adana su a farko a kan na'urarku.
privacy.encryption: Idan aka yi aiki tare da layi, ana ɓoye bayananku bisa ga ƙa'idodin tsaro da dokokin tsaro suka ba da shawara.
privacy.biometric_note: Alamomin halittar ku (yatsa, Face ID) ana sarrafa su ta tsarin tsaro na wayarku kawai kuma ba a taɓa aika su zuwa gare mu ba.
privacy.rights_intro: Dangane da dokokin Nijar da na al'umma, kuna da haƙƙoƙi masu zuwa:
privacy.rights_list:
• **Haƙƙin samun dama:** Samun tabbacin ana sarrafa bayananku.
• **Haƙƙin gyara:** Neman gyara bayanan da ba daidai ba.
• **Haƙƙin sharewa:** Neman share bayananku na dindindin.
• **Haƙƙin ƙin yarda:** Ƙin yarda da sarrafa bayananku don dalilai na halal.
privacy.exercise_rights: Yin amfani da hakkoki na: support@ajiyata.com
privacy.regulatory_desc: Idan aka sami sabani game da kare bayanan ku na sirri wanda tallafin mu bai warware ba, kuna da haƙƙin mika shi ga **Babbar Hukumar Kare Bayanan Sirri (HAPDP)** ta Jamhuriyar Nijar.
privacy.contact_desc: Ga kowace tambaya game da wannan manufar:

terms.title: Sharuɗɗan Amfani
terms.object_text: Waɗannan Sharuɗɗan Amfani (CGU) suna tsara samun dama da amfani da app ɗin wayar **Ajiya Ta**.
terms.acceptance: Amfani da app ɗin yana nufin karɓar waɗannan CGU ba tare da wani sharadi ba.
terms.service_desc: Ajiya Ta kayan aiki ne na sarrafa kasafin kuɗi da kuɗi na mutum. App ɗin yana ba da damar yin rikodin kuɗaɗen kuɗi, bin kasafin kuɗi da sarrafa asusu.
terms.service_warning: Ajiya Ta ba cibiyar bashi ba ce ko tsarin biyan kuɗi na banki. App ɗin kayan aiki ne na taimako don bin lissafin kuɗi na mutum.
terms.obligations_list:
Mai amfani ya himmatu:
• Shigar da bayanai daidai a ƙarƙashin alhakinsa kawai.
• Ba zai yi amfani da app ɗin don dalilai na zamba ko haram ba bisa ga dokokin Nijar da na duniya.
• Tabbatar da sirrin hanyoyin buɗe shi (lambar sirri, yatsa).
terms.liability_text: Ajiya Ta tana ba da lissafi da ƙididdiga don dalilai na nuni kawai. Ba za a iya ɗaukar nauyin mu ba idan akwai kuskuren shigar da mai amfani, asarar bayanai mai alaƙa da asara ko lalacewar na'urar wayar, ko katsewar sabis na ɗan lokaci.
terms.law_text: Ana gudanar da waɗannan CGU bisa ga **Dokar Jamhuriyar Nijar**.
terms.jurisdiction: Duk wani sabani game da fassara ko aiwatar da waɗannan CGU da ba za a iya warware shi cikin aminci ba, za a gabatar da shi ga ikon **Kotunan da suka dace na Niamey**.
